Attracted by new technologies since very young,
I passionate about IT and more specifically Internet and Web thereafter.
I made this passion my profession when entering the active life. My curiosity and taste of challenges I have to create the IDCI-Consulting company in end of 2007.
The philosophy of "Open Source" make me a satisfied libriste. RFC 2616 has become my "holy book" and the number 42 is often a choice of response to the problems I get asked.

Previously from the world of IT services, I am co-founder of IDCI-Consulting since 2007.
Today I put my 18 years of experience in the company's development.
In addition to the strategic directions that I determine with Baptiste & Gabriel, I manage particularly trade negotiations, finance and HRs to allow the operations team to focus on his heart craft.

Even though I fell in the IT world by chance, I stayed by passion.
Most of all, I love learning new things every days and use my knowledge to build apps easing everyday life.
My desire of freedom lead me to join IDCI-Consulting as a partner in 2015.
I hope I will always keep learning as well as discovering new activity fields by diving into the worlds of my clients.

«Everybody is a genius. But if you judge a fish by its ability to climb a tree, it will live its whole life believing that it is stupid.» - Albert Einstein


Initially, the IT world was not a familiar environment.
After nights and days of learning, I was passionate about this area.
Today, I like to translate ideas into a program and share my knowledge.
